verdict.rationale: Semgrep's own materials say it applies AI to the user's scan data. Semgrep Assistant does AI post-processing of findings to cut noise, the platform combines AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for triage and remediation, and AI-Powered Detection flags business-logic flaws. However, the evidence is short marketing and README lines with no documentation of how insights or suggestions are presented in the product. missing for 10: in-depth docs on Assistant's in-product insights and fix suggestions (UI, explanations, remediation guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of AI suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Contextual post-processing of findings with Semgrep Assistant (AI) to further reduce noise by ~20%
Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation
With AI-Powered Detection, you can automatically identify complex business logic flaws, such as IDORs and broken authorization.
